about_the_game:
The Forbidden Estate – The Grant Mansion

Part One of the Forbidden Estate Horror Series

Dare to step inside The Grant Mansion, a decaying estate whispered about in local legends. Once home to a wealthy collector obsessed with rare treasures, the mansion now lies in ruin… but its halls still guard priceless valuables.

You and your friends—or just you, if you’re brave enough—venture inside to uncover these treasures. But you’re not alone. The restless spirit of the mansion’s former owner roams the corridors, protecting what was once his.

Every creaking floorboard, every flickering light, every shadow in the corner of your eye could mean he’s near. If the ghost finds you, the hunt ends, and you’ll have to start over.

Search, survive, and escape with as much treasure as you can—before the mansion claims you as its next lost soul.

Key Features

  • Solo or Co-Op Multiplayer: Play alone for a nerve-wracking experience or team up with friends to increase your chances of survival.

  • Replayable Horror: Each run is different—treasures are scattered randomly, and the ghost’s behavior adapts to your actions.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Explore a richly detailed, crumbling mansion filled with secrets, hidden rooms, and haunting ambient sounds.

  • High-Stakes Survival: One wrong move can alert the ghost. If it catches you, the game restarts—can you make it out alive this time?
